eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Washoe, NV; at 9:09 PM on AUG 15, 2022 Effective until 11:09 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Fire in Galena evacuation advised. Most areas in Galena now open, EXCEPTIONS Big Pine Rd, Snow Flower Dr and Maggie Cir/Rd remain closed. Joy Lake Rd from Green Ash Rd to Nadia Ct also closed. Residents wishing to return to Joy Lake Rd check in with law enforcement. Evacuation point at Galena High School is closed. Please call 1-877-272-7337 Red Cross for individual assistance.
